title: CTU-13 selected scenario profile
publisher: Stratosphere IPS / Malware Capture Facility Project, Czech Technical University in Prague

permission_and_attribution.terms: The official MCFP scenario pages permit free use of the malware captures provided the authors and MCFP are credited and cited.
permission_and_attribution.required_citation: Sebastian Garcia, Martin Grill, Jan Stiborek, Alejandro Zunino. An empirical comparison of botnet detection methods. Computers & Security 45 (2014), 100-123.
permission_and_attribution.notice: This registry records the publisher's dataset-page terms; it is not a legal re-licensing of the captures.

qualification.capture_topology: Mixed normal, background, and botnet bidirectional flow exports from controlled CTU botnet scenarios; the public scenario PCAP files contain botnet traffic only, not the complete mixed capture.
qualification.clock_uncertainty: StartTime has second precision. Dur defines a flow activity interval. CTU publishes no independent collector availability or local-ingestion clock; replay assigns both to flow closure and records that assumption.
qualification.packet_completeness: The selected binetflow files contain flow records only. Packet timing, packet flags, packet sizes, TTL, TCP sequence/window, fragmentation, and retransmission fields are not observed and their validity bits remain false.
qualification.endpoint_linkage: IPv4 strings are observed addresses only. The adapter creates address-scoped entities and does not assert stable physical-device identity.
qualification.label_provenance: Publisher-provided per-flow labels. Only From-Normal is a verified benign negative. Background is a separate unknown class and is never converted to benign. From-Botnet is a weak malicious-endpoint-contact proxy; only labels explicitly containing CC, C&C, IRC, or command-and-control support the C2 task.

split_policy.note: No window from a scenario crosses partitions. With only three selected campaigns there is no independent development partition; adaptation uses fixed ADR-003 defaults and evidence is downgraded where event support is insufficient.
